info.title: 3X-UI Panel API
info.description: Programmatic interface to a 3X-UI panel. Authenticate either by logging in (cookie) or with a scoped API token from Settings → Security → API Token (Bearer). Token access is limited by its admin, monitor, node-sync, or node-admin scope; treat admin tokens like the panel password.

bearerAuth.description: Scoped API token from Settings → Security → API Token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

cookieAuth.name: 3x-ui
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie set by POST /login. Browser-only.

Incy client customization settings (app-management). A "" value omits
the header so the subscriber's own app setting is left alone.

subIncyAppAutoDetect.description:
Incy client customization settings (app-management). A "" value omits
the header so the subscriber's own app setting is left alone.

AmneziaWGLogs.description:
AmneziaWGLogs is what the overview's AmneziaWG log view renders: the live
per-peer activity of every running embedded interface, plus the panel's
own recent AmneziaWG lifecycle log lines that explain a peer being absent
from Peers at all.

example: 2025/01/01 12:00:00 amneziawg: started interface awg1 for inbound 1

token.description: SHA-256 hash; the plaintext is shown only once at creation

Client.description: Client represents a client configuration for Xray inbounds with traffic limits and settings.

allowedIPsByInbound.description:
AllowedIPsByInbound optionally overrides AllowedIPs on a per-inbound
basis, keyed by inbound id. Lets one identity attached to both
WireGuard and AmneziaWG carry two genuinely different addresses in a
single Create/Update call instead of the shared AllowedIPs field
being broadcast to every attached tunnel inbound. Absent/unset for a
given inbound id falls back to the shared AllowedIPs exactly as
before -- fully backward compatible for callers that never set this.

clientHostRuleIds.description:
ClientHostRuleIds binds the client to these host rules, one link each; nil preserves, empty
clears, and bindings with no usable host leave that inbound out of the subscription.

keepAlive.description: Numeric values or AmneziaWG ranges; 0 disables, omission preserves.

resetDay.description: Calendar renewal day 1-31, 0 disables monthly renewal

trafficReset.description: Per-client traffic reset cycle, independent of the inbound's own (#5497).

ClientPageResponse.description:
ClientPageResponse is the shape returned by ListPaged. `Total` is the
row count in the DB; `Filtered` is the count after Search/Filter/Protocol
were applied, before pagination. The page contains at most PageSize items.
Summary is computed across the full DB row set so dashboard counters
on the clients page stay stable as the user paginates/filters.

ClientSlim.description:
ClientSlim is the row-shape used by the clients page. It drops fields the
table never reads (UUID, password, auth, flow, security, reverse, tgId)
so the list payload stays compact even when the panel manages thousands
of clients. Modals that need the full record still call /get/:email.

ClientTraffic.description:
ClientTraffic represents traffic statistics and limits for a specific client.
It tracks upload/download usage, expiry times, and online status for inbound clients.

resetCount.description: ResetCount is how many have fired, so a prepaid plan stops on its own.

resetDay.description:
ResetDay renews on that day of each calendar month instead of every
Reset days; 0 disables monthly renewal.

resetMax.description: ResetMax caps how many times auto-renew may fire; 0 means no cap.

resetWeekday.description: ResetWeekday renews weekly at panel-local midnight: 1 Monday through 7 Sunday.

ClientsSummary.description:
ClientsSummary collects per-bucket counts plus the matching email lists so
the clients page can render the dashboard stat cards and their hover
popovers without shipping the full client array. The counters are exact;
the lists stop at clientSummaryEmailCap entries and only back the popovers.

FallbackParentInfo.description:
FallbackParentInfo carries everything the frontend needs to rewrite a
child inbound's client link: where to connect (the master's address
and port) and which path matched on the master's fallbacks array.
The frontend already has the master inbound in its dbInbounds list,
so we only ship identifiers + the match path here.

GeoCategory.description: GeoCategory is one code inside a database, such as geosite's "google".

GeoCategoryPage.description: GeoCategoryPage is one page of categories plus the unpaged total.

GeoEntry.description:
GeoEntry is a single rule inside a category: a domain rule for geosite
databases, a CIDR for geoip ones.

GeoEntryPage.description: GeoEntryPage is one page of category entries plus the unpaged total.

GeoFile.description: GeoFile describes one .dat database found in the asset directory.

GeodataTokenIssue.description:
GeodataTokenIssue reports a routing token the running core would reject,
or would silently match nothing against.

HistoryOfSeeders.description: HistoryOfSeeders tracks which database seeders have been executed to prevent re-running.

finalMask.description:
FinalMask is a JSON object of xray finalmask masks (tcp/udp/quicParams),
merged into this host's JSON-subscription stream. Empty = no override.

vlessRoute.description:
Single VLESS route value (0-65535) baked into the subscription UUID's 3rd
group (bytes 6-7), which xray reads via net.PortFromBytes(id[6:8]). Empty = none.

HwidSlotStatus.description:
HwidSlotStatus is the aggregate device-slot view exposed to subscribers:
counters only, no hwid value or hash, no email, no device metadata.

Inbound.description: Inbound represents an Xray inbound configuration with traffic statistics and settings.

excludeFromSub.description: Whether to omit this inbound from subscription output while keeping it operational

fallbackParent.description:
FallbackParent is populated by the API layer when this inbound is
attached as a fallback child of a VLESS/Trojan TCP-TLS master.
The frontend uses it to rewrite client-share links so they advertise
the master's externally reachable endpoint instead of the child's
loopback listen. Not persisted.

originNodeGuid.description:
OriginNodeGuid is the panelGuid of the node that physically hosts this
inbound, propagated up across hops (#4983). Empty for an inbound that
lives on this panel's own xray; set to the originating node's GUID when
the inbound was synced from a node (kept as-is across further hops). Lets
the master attribute a deeply nested inbound to the real node instead of
the intermediate one it was fetched through.

subSortIndex.description: Sort order of this inbound's links in subscription output only (lower first; negatives allowed; 0/omitted → 1; ties by id)

trafficResetDay.description: Day of month for monthly traffic resets

InboundClientIps.description: InboundClientIps stores IP addresses associated with inbound clients for access control.

awgServer.description:
AwgServer carries the full AmneziaWG server block (keys, subnet,
obfuscation params) so the clients page can render a downloadable
per-client .conf without a second round trip.

nodeAddress.description:
Share-host resolution inputs, mirroring the subscription's
resolveInboundAddress so the clients page renders a node-managed WireGuard
Endpoint that points at the node, not the master panel. NodeAddress is the
hosting node's externally reachable address (empty for this panel's own
inbounds); Listen and ShareAddrStrategy/ShareAddr feed the same
node→listen→custom fallback the share/QR links already use.

nodeId.description:
Hosting node; nil for this panel's own inbounds. Lets the clients
page map a node filter onto inbound IDs (#4997).

Node.description:
Node represents a remote 3x-ui panel registered with the central panel.
The central panel polls each node's existing /panel/api/server/status
endpoint over HTTP using the per-node ApiToken to populate the runtime
status fields below.

guid.description:
Guid is the remote panel's stable self-identifier (its panelGuid),
learned from each heartbeat. It is the globally stable node identity used
to attribute online clients/inbounds to the physical node across a chain
of nodes (#4983); panel-local autoincrement ids don't survive a hop.
Observed-state only — never user-edited.

parentGuid.description:
ParentGuid + Transitive are set only when a node is surfaced as part of a
node tree (#4983): direct nodes carry the master panel's own GUID, a
transitive sub-node carries its parent node's GUID. Transitive nodes are
read-only projections (Id == 0, not persisted) — never edited or deployed.

status.description:
Heartbeat-updated fields. UpdatedAt advances on every probe even when
the row is otherwise unchanged so the UI's "last seen" tooltip is
truthful without us having to read LastHeartbeat separately.
online|offline|unknown

unavailableMetrics.description: Nil on legacy rows and responses: zero remains a valid measured value.

xrayState.description:
XrayState and XrayError are captured from the remote node's /panel/api/server/status
during heartbeats. They let the central panel distinguish "panel API reachable"
(status=online) from "Xray core itself has failed on the node" for monitoring.

NodeMutationRequest.description:
NodeMutationRequest is the node write/probe contract. ApiToken is accepted
only as input. On update, nil means keep the stored token; replacement and
clearing are explicit and mutually exclusive.

NodeView.description:
NodeView is the browser/API read contract for nodes. Credentials are
write-only: responses expose only whether a node has a token configured.

OutboundTraffics.description: OutboundTraffics tracks traffic statistics for Xray outbound connections.

PeerActivity.description:
PeerActivity is one peer's live embedded-Device-reported state, the
counterpart of an Xray access-log entry: a tunnel logs no requests, only
handshakes and bytes.

handshake.description: Handshake is unix milliseconds, 0 when the peer has never connected.

xrayState.description:
XrayState/XrayError are populated on successful probes even when the node's
Xray core is not healthy. The UI uses them for a distinct "panel ok, xray failed" indicator.

Readiness.description: Readiness is the host's ability to run any kernel-mode inbound at all.

certChainBytes.description:
CertChainBytes is the sum of DER lengths of the presented peer chain.
xray-core ML-DSA-65 REALITY needs >= 3500 bytes (constant lives in xray-core).

certChainValid.description:
CertChainValid ignores the name: a trusted chain presented for other names
still has serverNames the panel can offer instead of the failing SNI.

privateTarget.description:
PrivateTarget marks a target that resolves to a loopback/private/link-local
address: blocked before the probe unless the caller opted in, then flagged.

ServerSettings.description:
ServerSettings is the "server" block of an AmneziaWG inbound's Settings
JSON: the interface-level configuration shared by every client/peer. The
listen port is deliberately not duplicated here — it lives on the inbound
row itself (Inbound.Port), like every other protocol.

externalInterface.description:
ExternalInterface, IPv6Enabled, and IPv6ExternalInterface are live
again as of Phase 3.5 -- see the matching fields on Instance for what
they gate (internal/amneziawgnet's IPv6-address-alias mechanism).
IPv6Subnet was never actually vestigial either: InstanceFromInbound
already consumes it (via serverAddressV6) to build the server's own
tunnel address, same as always. Only RouteThroughXray, below, remains
genuinely vestigial as of the hard cutover to the embedded path
(internal/amneziawgnet) -- read from existing stored settings for
backward compatibility, but not acted on by anything.

headerProtectionKey.description:
HeaderProtectionKey and ContentPaddingAddition are AmneziaWG 3.0
fields, flat and top-level for the same tools/openapigen reason as
the block above; Obfuscation() below folds them back into
Obfuscation31's own identically named fields.
HeaderProtectionKey is a base64 32-byte key; empty (the default)
disables AWG 3.0 header protection. A non-empty value requires
every one of S1-S4 above to be >= 12 -- ValidateObfuscation
enforces this at save time, not just at IpcSet time.
ContentPaddingAddition is a "low-high" range or bare integer, the
same grammar and uint32 cap as H1-H4.

jc.description:
Obfuscation31's fields, repeated flat (not embedded) rather than
nested under their own key: encoding/json would happily inline an
embedded Obfuscation31 the same way, but the frontend's Go->Zod/TS
generator (tools/openapigen) does not — it emits a genuinely nested
`obfuscation31` object, which would silently diverge from the real
wire JSON. See Obfuscation() below for the manager-facing conversion.

kernelMode.description:
KernelMode runs this inbound on the AmneziaWG kernel module (internal/amneziawgkern)
instead of the embedded amneziawg-go + gVisor stack.

primaryDns.description:
PrimaryDNS/SecondaryDNS seed client configs' DNS line. Blank is
meaningful, so no omitempty: a dropped key resurrects frontend defaults.

randomTrailers.description:
RandomTrailers/DisableCookies mirror Instance's identically named
AmneziaWG 3.1 fields -- see that type's own doc comment for the real
protocol/interop details. Both real bool fields (not omitempty):
buildUAPIConfig always emits both lines explicitly so the
reconfigure-in-place diff correctly notices a true->false edit, not
just false->true.

rekeyAfterTime.description:
RekeyAfterTime/RekeyTimeout/RejectAfterTime/KeepaliveTimeout/
MaxHandshakeAttempts mirror Instance's identically named fields --
see that type's own doc comment for the grammar/width/real-default
details. Flat and top-level for the same tools/openapigen reason as
the rest of this struct.

Setting.description: Setting stores key-value configuration settings for the 3x-ui panel.

SubBalancer.description:
SubBalancer is one extra JSON-subscription config document whose members are
the selected inbounds' proxy outbounds. SortOrder shares SubSortIndex semantics.

enabled.description:
No gorm default:true — a bool default makes an explicit false at insert
collapse back to the column default (zero value is skipped).

memberWeights.description:
inboundId -> leastLoad weight; absent entries mean 1.0. Only meaningful
with Strategy "leastLoad" — xray ignores costs on every other strategy.

TgBotCapabilities.description: TgBotCapabilities is the browser-safe shape of the bot's own capabilities.

groupPrivacy.description:
GroupPrivacy off means the bot reads every group message; when it is on,
a bare /start in a group is invisible to the bot.

Traffic.description:
Traffic represents network traffic statistics for Xray connections.
It tracks upload and download bytes for inbound or outbound traffic.

User.description: User represents a user account in the 3x-ui panel.

payload.description: 根据 type 选择数据结构，详见 GET /ws 的 x-websocket-events。

time.description: 服务器发送时刻的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。

tags.name: 身份验证
tags.description: 支持两种身份验证方式：浏览器会话使用登录接口设置的 Cookie；机器人、脚本和远程面板使用“设置 → 安全 → API 令牌”中的 Bearer 令牌。两种方式均适用于 /panel/api/* 下的所有接口。

tags.name: 入站管理
tags.description: 管理入站及其客户端。接口位于 /panel/api/inbounds，需要已登录会话或 Bearer 令牌。生成链接时，仅信任来自已配置可信代理的转发请求头。

tags.name: 服务器
tags.description: 系统状态、日志、证书生成、Xray 程序管理和备份恢复，接口均位于 /panel/api/server。

tags.name: 客户端
tags.description: 将客户端作为独立实体管理，可关联一个或多个入站。同一客户端记录用于生成所属各入站的 settings.clients 项。接口位于 /panel/api/clients。

tags.name: 节点管理
tags.description: 管理作为主面板节点的远程 3x-ui 面板，接口均位于 /panel/api/nodes。

tags.name: 主机管理
tags.description: 管理入站主机覆盖配置。每个已启用主机使用自身地址、端口和 TLS 生成额外订阅链接，替代旧 externalProxy 数组。接口位于 /panel/api/hosts。

tags.name: 备份
tags.description: 与已配置 Telegram 机器人交互的操作。

tags.name: 面板设置
tags.description: 面板配置及管理员凭据，接口位于 /panel/api/setting，需要登录会话或 Bearer 令牌。

tags.name: API 令牌
tags.description: 管理程序调用使用的 Bearer 权限令牌。admin 可操作全部面板 API；monitor 仅读取状态和指标；node-sync 管理节点配置但不能更新面板；node-admin 额外允许面板自更新。令牌可设置到期时间，以 SHA-256 存储，明文仅创建时返回一次。

tags.name: Xray 设置
tags.description: Xray 配置模板、出站管理、Warp/Nord/PIA 集成及配置测试，接口位于 /panel/api/xray。

tags.name: 订阅负载均衡
tags.description: JSON 订阅中的客户端负载均衡。每个启用项生成一份额外配置，成员为选中入站的代理出站，使用 routing.balancers 和 burstObservatory。在“设置 → 订阅负载均衡”中管理。

tags.name: 订阅服务器
tags.description: 向客户端提供标准、JSON 和 Clash 订阅的独立 HTTP/HTTPS 服务。使用独立端口，默认 2096，在“设置 → 订阅”配置。新安装为各格式生成随机路径前缀，仍可自行修改。各订阅接口通过响应头提供流量和期限信息。

tags.name: WebSocket 实时事件
tags.description: 通过 WebSocket 实时更新状态。连接 ws:///ws 后持续接收 JSON 消息，无需轮询。需要已验证的会话 Cookie，不支持 Bearer 令牌。各消息以 type 字段标识载荷结构。

post.summary: 使用用户名和密码登录并获取会话 Cookie。使用 Cookie 调用接口前必须先登录。

twoFactorCode.description: 启用双重验证时填写一次性验证码，否则省略。

post.summary: 清除会话 Cookie。浏览器会话需携带 CSRF 请求头。

get.summary: 为当前会话生成 CSRF 令牌，前端在修改请求的 X-CSRF-Token 请求头中发送。使用 Bearer 令牌验证的 API 调用不需要此令牌。

post.summary: 返回面板是否启用双重验证，登录页据此决定是否显示一次性验证码输入框。

get.summary: 列出当前用户的所有入站及 clientStats 流量计数。settings、streamSettings 和 sniffing 返回嵌套 JSON 对象；写入时仍兼容旧版 JSON 编码字符串。
与 /list 结构相同，但 settings.clients[] 仅保留 {email, enable, comment}，ClientStats 不包含 UUID/SubId。适合列表页；需要 uuid、password、flow 等完整信息时请求 /get/:id。

返回轻量入站选项：id、remark、tag、protocol、port、tlsFlowCapable 和 ssMethod。tlsFlowCapable 表示 TCP 上启用 TLS/Reality 的 VLESS，或 XHTTP 上启用 VLESS 加密的 VLESS；ssMethod 为 Shadowsocks 加密方式，供生成 2022 PSK 使用。省略 settings、streamSettings 和 clientStats，适合大量客户端场景中的选择器。
检查主机能否通过内核模块运行 AmneziaWG 入站，返回 ready、root/tools/module/nft 阻塞代码及修复命令。保存入站时还会拒绝内核后端不支持的 IPv6、端口转发、routeThroughXray 和固定监听地址。
导出所有入站和客户端的协议链接（vless://、vmess://、trojan://、ss://、hysteria://、mtproto）。通过订阅引擎应用每个客户端的备注模板，与客户端详情和二维码中的链接一致。不具备链接格式的 socks、http、mixed、wireguard、dokodemo、tunnel 不输出。
按数字编号获取单个入站。

post.summary: 创建入站，提交完整配置：protocol、port、settings、streamSettings、sniffing、remark、expiryTime、total、enable。配置对象建议直接嵌套，也兼容旧版 JSON 编码字符串。
按编号删除入站，同时删除关联客户端的流量统计记录。
批量删除入站，按列表顺序处理。逐项报告失败，其余项继续执行，最多重启一次 Xray。
替换入站配置，请求结构与 /add 相同，但保留已存储的客户端列表和启用状态，忽略请求中的 settings.clients 与 enable。客户端通过 /panel/api/clients 管理，启用状态通过 /setEnable 修改。
仅修改 enable 标志，无需序列化整个 settings。推荐用于大入站的界面开关。
仅修改订阅排序。读取已保存的入站，避免排序请求用旧客户端列表覆盖并发编辑。
清零单个入站的上传和下载计数，不修改客户端计数。
删除某个入站中的所有客户端，保留入站本身。从 settings.clients[] 收集标识后批量移除运行时用户、清理流量记录并同步入站。此操作不可撤销。
清零所有入站的上传和下载计数，历史计量数据将丢失。
从 JSON 导入入站，例如界面导出的配置。使用表单编码，通过单个 data 字段提交。

data.description: 经过 JSON 编码的入站配置。

post.summary: 接收主面板汇总的客户端用量，以主面板 GUID 区分来源。保存在独立表中，仅用于界面叠加显示和本地额度控制，不混入供主面板轮询的本地计数，避免破坏增量计量。由节点流量同步任务调用。

masterGuid.description: 推送数据的主面板稳定 GUID。

traffics.description: 客户端流量记录，仅读取 email、up、down。

get.summary: 列出 VLESS/Trojan TCP-TLS 主入站的回落规则。每项关联一个子入站及可选 SNI/ALPN/path/dest/xver 条件。dest 为空时使用子入站的监听地址和端口。

post.summary: 替换主入站的全部回落规则，使用 JSON 请求正文，并触发 Xray 重启。

fallbacks.description: 由 {childId, name, alpn, path, dest, xver, sortOrder} 组成的数组。dest 留空时使用子入站监听地址和端口，也可指定 8443、127.0.0.1:8443 或 /dev/shm/x.sock 等值覆盖。

get.summary: 以 OpenAPI 3 格式返回当前接口文档，也是面板 API 文档页的数据来源。与其他 /panel/api 接口一样需要会话或 Bearer 令牌，可用于生成客户端或导入接口工具。
实时主机快照：CPU、内存、交换空间、磁盘、网络读写、负载、连接数和 Xray 状态。后台每两秒更新缓存。
检查主机能否实施客户端 IP 限制，面板据此控制“IP 限制”字段是否可用。此功能依赖 Fail2ban。
旧版 CPU 汇总历史。请改用 /history/cpu/:bucket，数据相同，统一采用 {t, v} 结构。
返回某项指标最近约六小时的聚合时序数据，样本结构为 {t, v}。
返回 Xray 运行指标状态，包括是否配置 metrics、已产生数据的 expvar 键及当前快照。未配置指标时返回空状态。
返回某项 Xray 运行指标最近约六小时的历史，结构与 /history/:metric/:bucket 相同，为 {t, v}。
返回 Xray 连接观测的最新快照，包括各出站的延迟、健康状态和最后探测时间。仅在配置了连接观测时有数据。
返回某个出站标签的连接观测历史，与其他历史接口一样采用 {t, v} 结构。

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: 连接观测配置中的出站标签。

get.summary: 列出此主机可安装的 Xray 版本。
检查 GitHub 上是否有更新的 3x-ui 版本。
返回最近一次面板自更新的结果。将 runId 与 POST updatePanel 返回值对比，以区分当前运行和旧结果。
返回此主机当前运行的完整 Xray 配置。
下载完整数据库备份。SQLite 面板返回 .db 文件，PostgreSQL 面板返回 pg_dump 自定义格式的 .dump 文件，可用作手动备份。
下载跨数据库引擎迁移文件。SQLite 返回 SQL 文本 .dump，PostgreSQL 返回基于实时数据生成的 SQLite .db 文件。
生成 UUID v4，可用于客户端标识。
返回当前面板 Web TLS 证书和密钥的文件路径。主面板通过节点 API 令牌调用，使分配到节点的入站能够使用节点本机证书路径。
只读返回当前面板管理的节点摘要：guid、parentGuid、name、address、status 和版本。上级面板通过节点 API 令牌读取，用于展示链式拓扑中的间接节点。节点数量由上级面板计算。
生成 Reality 使用的 X25519 密钥对。
生成 ML-DSA-65 密钥对，返回 {seed, verify}。

post.description:
未提供的密钥由服务端补全，调用方提供的有效值不会被覆盖。重新添加已存在的 email 并提供其已存储的 subId 时，会复用 id、password、auth 和 secret，保持各入站身份一致。

- VLESS/VMess：生成 UUID 作为 id。
- Trojan：生成 password。
- Shadowsocks：生成 password。对 2022-blake3-*，如果提供的密码无法通过 Base64 解码为对应加密方式要求的 16 或 32 字节，会替换为生成密钥，接口仍成功；如未交由服务端选择，应回读客户端确认。传统加密方式保留所有非空密码。
- Hysteria：生成 auth。
- mtproto：按入站前置域名生成 FakeTLS secret，未设置域名时使用 www.cloudflare.com。
- WireGuard：privateKey/publicKey 均空时生成密钥对；仅有 privateKey 时补公钥。allowedIPs 从现有对等节点所在 /24 分配空闲 /32；无现有节点时使用 10.0.0.0/24。

preSharedKey、keepAlive（WireGuard）和 adTag（mtproto）可提交，但不会自动生成。

WireGuard 地址分配失败时会先扩大到所在 /16 搜索，然后返回无空闲地址错误。显式 allowedIPs 只验证不分配；与同一或其他 WireGuard/AmneziaWG 入站中其他客户端的地址或前缀重叠时拒绝。按地址范围比较，因此 10.0.0.9/24 与 10.0.0.5/32 冲突；0.0.0.0/0 和 ::/0 默认路由不占用地址。自动分配也跳过已占用前缀，关联客户端接口同样执行此验证。

任何 inboundIds 不存在时整次调用在写入前拒绝。此后各入站独立并发执行，某项失败不阻止其他入站，因此 success:false 仍可能部分创建成功。错误带有入站编号，多项错误分行报告。仅所有入站成功时应用 limitHwid，修复失败后可重新调用。

删除节点，不自动迁移关联入站。
暂停或恢复与此节点的流量同步。
使用请求正文中的连接信息测试节点，不保存，返回与已注册节点相同的心跳快照。

使用尚未保存的节点连接信息，列出可选择导入的远程入站。
探测已存在的节点并更新健康状态缓存。
对指定节点调用官方面板自更新程序，下载最新版本并重启。仅处理已启用且在线节点，其余列为跳过。dev:true 使用随提交滚动发布的开发渠道，否则使用最新稳定版。返回逐节点结果。

一次保存全部设置，结构与 /all 返回值相同。无效端口、缺少证书配对等问题在写入前拒绝。
使用服务端 Go RE2 编译器验证正则表达式，不保存。

等待三秒后重启整个 3x-ui 进程。连接立即断开，面板通常在约 5-10 秒后恢复。
分阶段测试 SMTP 连接，包括连接、认证和发送，返回包含阶段及消息的结构化结果。
向已配置的会话发送测试消息，以测试 Telegram 机器人连接。
返回机器人能力。内联模式由 BotFather 控制，未开启时面板会显示提示。
向已配置频道发送测试嵌入消息，以测试 Discord 机器人连接。

enabled.description: 是否输出此负载均衡配置。创建时默认为 true，更新时省略则保留原值。

delete.summary: 按编号删除负载均衡配置。

post.summary: 按编号删除负载均衡配置，为不支持 DELETE 的客户端提供 POST 等价接口。

get.summary: 返回匹配订阅标识的所有已启用客户端链接，使用 Base64 编码。Accept:text/html 或 ?html=1 时显示详情页；?format=info 返回流量、期限和在线状态的 JSON 视图模型，不含链接，供实时轮询。路径前缀由 subPath 配置。

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: 设为 info 时返回订阅状态的 JSON 视图模型，而非链接。

head.summary: 返回与 GET 相同的状态和订阅元数据响应头，无响应正文。

200.description: 订阅可用。响应头与 GET 相同，无响应正文。

404.description: 没有与此订阅标识匹配的已启用客户端。

get.summary: 返回订阅的 HWID 设备名额汇总：限制是否启用、名额上限、已注册数量和剩余数量。此接口只读，不注册设备或占用名额，仅返回计数，不包含 HWID、email 或设备信息。路径前缀由 subPath 配置。
get.description: 与其他订阅服务接口一样，直接返回 HwidSlotStatus 对象，不使用面板 {success,msg,obj} 包装。未配置 HWID 限制时，active 为 false，所有计数为 0。

404.description: 没有与此订阅标识匹配的已启用客户端，响应正文为空。

500.description: 数据库查询失败，响应正文为空。

head.summary: 返回与 GET 相同的 HWID 设备名额状态码和响应头，无响应正文。

200.description: 响应头与 GET 相同，无响应正文。

404.description: 没有与此订阅标识匹配的已启用客户端，响应正文为空。

get.summary: 以 JSON 数组返回代理配置，每个启用客户端一份。仅在设置中启用 JSON 订阅时提供，路径前缀由 subJsonPath 配置。

head.summary: 返回 JSON 订阅状态和元数据响应头，无正文。仅在启用 JSON 订阅时注册此路由。

200.description: 订阅可用。响应头与 GET 相同，无响应正文。

404.description: 没有与此订阅标识匹配的已启用客户端。

get.summary: 返回兼容 Clash/Mihomo 的 YAML 配置，包括已配置的全局 Clash 路由规则。仅在启用 Clash 订阅时提供，路径前缀由 subClashPath 配置。

head.summary: 返回 Clash 订阅状态和元数据响应头，无正文。仅在启用 Clash 订阅时注册此路由。

200.description: 订阅可用。响应头与 GET 相同，无响应正文。

404.description: 没有与此订阅标识匹配的已启用客户端。

get.summary: 将 HTTP 连接升级为 WebSocket，需要已验证的会话 Cookie，不支持 Bearer 令牌。成功返回 101 状态码，随后服务器推送下述 JSON 消息。

101.description: 协议切换成功，WebSocket 消息使用 WebSocketEnvelope。

401.description: 未提供已验证的面板会话 Cookie。

x-websocket-events.summary: 每两秒推送服务器健康快照，内容与 server/status 的 obj 相同。
实时流量增量、在线客户端、各节点状态和最后在线时间。TUIC 还会发送带来源标记及采样间隔的客户端增量，用于计算实时速率。

clientTrafficSource.description: 原生 TUIC 采样时提供此字段；Xray 采样省略时默认为 xray。

clientTrafficIntervalMs.description: 计算客户端速率的采样间隔，单位为毫秒。

x-websocket-events.summary: 客户端累计流量与入站摘要。snapshot 表示 clients 是完整列表还是仅包含近期活动记录。
入站变更后的完整入站列表；大规模数据时改用 invalidate 通知重新获取。
定期流量采集后的当前出站流量记录。
心跳探测周期结束后的当前节点树。
服务器操作触发的面板内通知。

payload.title: Xray service restarted
payload.message: Xray service has been restarted successfully

x-websocket-events.summary: 停止、重启或发生错误后的 Xray 进程状态变化。
通知重新请求 REST 接口。clients 是 invalidate 载荷类型，不是顶层事件。
